info.title: Il Grande Sogno di Maya (2005)
info.synopsis: Kitajima Maya è una ragazzina di 13 anni che vive da sola con la madre. Nonostante le difficoltà, Maya affronta la vita grazie al suo entusiasmo e alla sua passione per il teatro. Un giorno viene notata dall'attrice di successo Chigusa Tsukikage, che decide di prenderla come propria allieva nella sua scuola di recitazione. Tutte le sfide che Maya affronterà sono rivolte ad un unico scopo: riuscire ad ottenere la parte della protagonista ne La Dea Scarlatta, un'opera teatrale leggendaria di cu ila signora Tsukikage detiene i diritti. Nel corso del tempo, Maya avrà il sostegno di un ammiratore segreto (in realtà l'affarista Masumi Hayami) che le invia un mazzo di rose in occasione di ogni sua interpretazione.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Life so far for Kitajima Maya has been rough. One day she gets a small part in a school play and now her life has suddenly turned around.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Tsukikage makes arrangements for Maya to transfer to another school; she also starts training her to become an actress.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Kazehaya asks Sawako to meet him after school to discuss her study habits and for help with his homework.  The other students learn she is a great teacher, and she starts helping out her other classmates.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Maya asks Tsukikage if she can work her way through acting school. Tsukikage agrees to give her a scholarship to the Tsukikage Acting Troupe.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Maya takes a job working in the park so that she doesn't have to borrow too much money from Tsukikage. Tsukikage gives the girls a new acting assigment which is to do a play only using four words.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Tsukikage told the class their new play will be "Little Women" and Maya has been cast as the third sister, Beth. Maya now has to live as Beth for a week in order to better understand her role.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: All the critics show up to review the Tsukikage's Acting Troupe's first play. Maya receives a bouquet of purple roses from her first fan.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The investors visit Tsukikage after her release from the hospital and tell her she has to enter the upcoming acting competition in Nagoya.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Tsukikage Acting Troupe finds out the Ondine Troupe is also performing Takekurabe and that Ayumi will be Midori. The troupe starts rehearsals and Tsukikage really pushes Maya. This causes Maya to create her role and to make her own Midori.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The Tsukikage Acting Troupe and Ondine Troupe will go head to head in today's competition.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Tsukikage Acting Troupe is again favored to win in the National Acting Competition. The night before their competition someone destroys all of their props and costumes.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Since the cast does not return in time for the competition, Maya volunteers to perform solo.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The girls ask Tsukikage if she will still teach them acting now that the troupe has been disbanded. Sakurakouji tries to persuade Maya to join is acting troupe.

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: Ayumi vows to take any role possible. The schools' acting troupe is putting on a new production. When the lead actress has to be rushed to the emergency room, Maya volunteers to tackle the role.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Maya gets a role with another troupe after impressing them with her audition. The girl whose spot Maya took has something up for sleeve for Maya.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: Miss Harada informs Tsukikage that they will never hire Maya again even though they know she will take the stage by storm one day. Maya auditions for "Wuthering Heights."

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: As more people see the play during it's run, the audience is becoming more confused because the younger actors play with much more intensity than their adult actors. Due to this the play receives bad reviews.

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Tsukikage pulls the troupe together to perform the play "The Stone's Smile" with Maya in the role of the doll. On the 10th days of performances they are a sell out.

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: Maya loses her concentration during the play thus causing her to lose her mask as she is thinking about her Mom she just saw on the street.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: Maya goes on stage when called even though she does not know her lines as someone switched her script.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: All the girls auditioning for the role spend the summer rehearsing for their chance to play Helen Keller.

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: The judges pick both Maya and Ayumi to be Helen and they will alternate who plays Helen during the run.

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: Ayumi and Maya both perform their versions of Helen for the Theater Festival; Ayumi is first to perform.

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: After Maya accepts the award for Best Supporting Actress, Tsukikage comes onstage and offers both Maya and Ayumi the chance to play the lead role in "The Scarlet Angel".

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: Masumi's people have found Maya's Mother but Masumi decides to keep that information to himself. Maya starts to realize how jealous people are of her success.

episodes.title: Episodio 26
episodes.synopsis: Someone is out to sabotage Maya as so far they have spiked her food, removed bolts from set props and made a bucket of water fall on her.

episodes.title: Episodio 27
episodes.synopsis: Maya's personal assistant, Norie Otobe, is bullied by Miss Mizuki.

episodes.title: Episodio 28
episodes.synopsis: Maya believes that Hayami Masumi killed her mother, meanwhile Miss Mizuki is worried about Maya's sudden disappearance.

episodes.title: Episodio 29
episodes.synopsis: Masumi Hayami continues to criticize Maya on her acting abilities.

episodes.title: Episodio 30
episodes.synopsis: Ayumi finds Maya choking on the fake balls of mud from the play.

episodes.title: Episodio 31
episodes.synopsis: Maya performs a solo show to her audience.

episodes.title: Episodio 32
episodes.synopsis: Ayumi Himekawa wins an award for her acting ability. Tsukikage declares there that Maya has two years to win the Best Actress Award or the role of the Scarlet Angel goes to Ayumi. The Tsukikage and Ikkakujuu acting troupes decide to put on Shakespeare's "A Midsummer Night's Dream" in an outdoor theater with Maya playing the role of the fairy Puck. Can Maya learn to move like Puck in time for the performance?

episodes.title: Episodio 33
episodes.synopsis: Masumi Hayami lectures a small outdoor theater troupe about their play and gives them crucial advice. The night of the first show has arrived and Maya is ready to ignite the crowd with her version of Puck. Will the play be a success?

episodes.title: Episodio 34
episodes.synopsis: A fundraiser performance by the Tsukikage Acting Troupe and the Ikkakujuu Troupe of "A Midsummer Night's Dream" was an instant hit! But Maya was cut from the show... what does Masumi Hayami have in store for her?

episodes.title: Episodio 35
episodes.synopsis: Maya reads a story about two princesses, Aldis and Orgeld.

episodes.title: Episodio 36
episodes.synopsis: Maya meets an actress who once played Aldis in a play.

episodes.title: Episodio 37
episodes.synopsis: Maya takes the role as Princess Aldis in the play "The Two Princesses".

episodes.title: Episodio 38
episodes.synopsis: The play continues as Maya's role of Aldis is challenged.

episodes.title: Episodio 39
episodes.synopsis: "The Two Princesses" approaches its final show.

episodes.title: Episodio 40
episodes.synopsis: Maya's newest play is "The Forgotten Wilderness," in which she plays a girl raised by wolves.

episodes.title: Episodio 41
episodes.synopsis: An open casting call for "The Forgotten Wilderness" brings in some very inexperienced yet eager actors and actresses.

episodes.title: Episodio 42
episodes.synopsis: Getting into her role, Maya travels in to the mountainous wilderness to further understand her character.

episodes.title: Episodio 43
episodes.synopsis: "The Forgotten Wilderness" begins rehearsal.

episodes.title: Episodio 44
episodes.synopsis: It's opening night for "The Forgotten Wilderness" and already a huge line has formed!

episodes.title: Episodio 45
episodes.synopsis: Thirty years have passed since Chigusa Tsukikage, Maya's mentor, was in the public eye.

episodes.title: Episodio 46
episodes.synopsis: Masumi Hayami runs into Maya on the bullet train station and encourages her to continue pursuing her dream.

episodes.title: Episodio 47
episodes.synopsis: In the countryside, Maya contemplates her life while watching the fire.

episodes.title: Episodio 48
episodes.synopsis: Masumi reads the story of The Scarlet Angel to Maya.

episodes.title: Episodio 49
episodes.synopsis: On her death bed, Ichiren Ozaki recalls her life.

episodes.title: Episodio 50
episodes.synopsis: While crossing an eerie bridge deep in the forest, the bridge suddenly breaks and Maya falls through.

episodes.title: Episodio 51
episodes.synopsis: The Scarlet Angel finally reveals herself!

related.title: Glass no Kamen (ITA)
related.plot: Maya Kitajima ha 13 anni. Non è particolarmente carina, né più intelligente delle sue coetanee: è una ragazza comune. Ma la sua passione per la recitazione non ha eguali, tanto da scappare di casa per entrare nella compagnia teatrale della signora Tsukikage. Qui scoprirà l’amicizia, l’invidia e la severità del mondo, ma anche le nuove emozioni regalate da un misterioso ammiratore che le invia rose ad ogni esibizione, e la lotta senza quartiere per assicurarsi i diritti de “La Dea Scarlatta”, una leggendaria piecè teatrale gelosamente custodita dall’inflessibile signora Tsukikage, e che nessuno sembra essere all’altezza di interpretare.

related.title: Glass no Kamen: Sen no Kamen wo Motsu Shoujo (ITA)
related.plot: Kitajima Maya è una giovane ragazza con la passione per i film, per gli spettacoli teatrali e per i drammi TV. Un giorno la famosa attrice Chigusa Tsukikage scorge Maya mentre recita parti di uno sceneggiato davanti a dei bambini; vedendo in lei un grande talento decide di prendere la ragazza sotto la propria ala protettiva, introducendola al mondo della recitazione.
